BlackEarly.review: Reviewed clip seconds 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Lower central bed/black object corridor; extruder heavily occludes print. Experimental crop may exclude debris.

PinkNetriti.review: Reviewed clip seconds 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Pink print and its observed displacement corridor; head still occludes upper object.

WhiteHorseback.review: Reviewed clip seconds 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Broad lower bed corridor covering displaced white print; includes nozzle and reflected light.

YellowEarly.review: Reviewed clip seconds 0,20,40,58 and prior paired run at 960x720. Green print corridor; lower frame crop excludes logo but cannot reveal occluded material.

P2RedSkull.review: Reviewed clip seconds 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Different P2 camera: broad central bed region around red print/debris. Includes nozzle and some housing; excludes rear PCs and front bed hardware.

BlackMoai.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 clip seconds at 960x720. Tall black print falls across nearly the entire view; broad swept-region crop retains the fall and loose strand. Little background can be excluded safely.

BlackWobbly.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 clip seconds at 960x720. Black print shifts strongly toward the right edge; broad middle/lower crop covers its observed sweep, with possible nozzle overlap.

BlueHourse.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 clip seconds at 960x720. Tall blue print falls rightward; crop includes both upright/fallen positions and visibly loose filament above the fallen object. Positive candidate preserved.

BlueMonk.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Upright blue figure tilts and returns; covers full object and leaning corridor, excluding most upper housing.

GreenNeedle.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Tall green column remains upright but shifts laterally; includes its full height and the nozzle-adjacent top without unrelated side equipment.

OrangeLibery.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Tall orange statue swings strongly while attached to the nozzle; broad crop spans tilted and upright positions rather than only its base.

PinkMan.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Pink torso and support structure occupy the right half; crop spans the detached cylinder and supports while excluding most upper housing.

RedHeart.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Red object stays centered but rocks with nozzle; preserves full object height and base, allowing modest lateral motion.

WhiteBoat.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. White boat shifts/rotates on left bed; retains the hull, top and surrounding debris corridor rather than following the nozzle.

WhiteBust.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. White support/print fragments remain under the head; crop covers their sideways movement and base, with substantial occlusion still present.

WhiteNeitiri_SupportFail.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. White low structure and supports beneath extruder; preserve broken/tilted fragments and surrounding bed, not only a narrow silhouette.

WhiteNetiri_Fallover.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Large head falls rightward while loose strands appear high in the scene; broad near-full-frame crop intentionally preserves both object trajectory and filament rather than suppressing background at the expense of recall.

WhiteTotem.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. White sculpted object tilts then shifts rightward; includes upper surface, base and entire observed sweep with some unavoidable nozzle overlap.

YellowArch.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Two widely separated arch legs and a fallen leg span most of the view; ROI retains both and hanging filament. Background logo between legs cannot be excluded by a single rectangle.

YellowCat.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Yellow figure translates/rotates; broad object crop retains upper loose-looking material and later rightward footprint.

YellowOval_still.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 960x720. Yellow oval tips and develops hanging strands; includes upright/fallen body and nozzle-to-bed filament corridor rather than only the bed footprint.

BlackFrancesco.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080 (P2 camera). Narrow black printed structure under nozzle tilts left; crop covers both positions and nearby bed without rear PCs/front bed adjustment hardware.

BrownAugustus.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Brown figure and thin supports beneath nozzle; crop covers leaning structure, separate support poles and surrounding bed, excluding most rear PCs.

GreenCase.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Low green case moves along the rear-middle bed; shallow ROI retains displaced green material and nozzle tip while avoiding most extruder housing and rear objects.

GreenSkullEarly.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Green footprint and loose-looking material sweep across rear-middle bed; broader horizontal crop retains debris seen on either side of the nozzle.

P2BlueDragon.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Two broad blue sections shift laterally and lift; wide object-level crop preserves both components and intervening strands rather than centering only the nozzle.

P2BrownBridge.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Broad brown arch and collapsing interior supports; retains whole arch plus filament near nozzle and bed without tight geometry masking.

P2OrageLion.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Large orange print and tall support occupy much of bed width; crop retains full printed surface and base, excluding upper extruder and front hardware.

P2RedVase.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Red vase stays near center with slight tilting/translation; crop includes complete vase, top/nozzle interface, skirt and nearby bed.

PinkPenholder.review: Reviewed 0,20,40,58 at 1920x1080. Pink low-wall object slides rightward; includes initial/final footprint and loose-looking strands on its left, excluding most upper housing.
